title: 21 Daily Social Media Salon Marketing Ideas (Updated 2024)

facts.fact: Hootsuite's research recommends posting to Instagram 2-7 times per week.
Hootsuite's research recommends posting to Twitter 1-5 times per day.
Hootsuite's research recommends posting to Facebook 1-2 times per day.
Hootsuite's research recommends posting to LinkedIn 1-5 times per day.
The article's advice is to start posting on social media at least once a day.
facts.quote: Aim to start posting at least once a day and go from there.

facts.fact: The article is published with a timestamp of May 2, 2024.
The article recommends that salon owners not post on every social media channel, only those their audience frequents most.
facts.quote: you don’t have to post on _every_ social media channel, just the ones your audience frequents the most.
